sentences.text:
1 This writ petition is filed to quash the impugned proceedings bearing No. Na.ka. 16342/ 2021/ B-1 dated 23.09.2022 as illegal, void in law, rife with infirmities and consequently direct the respondent to pass appropriate orders on merits and in accordance with law and Reconvey the unutilised lands in Survey No.259/ 1B1A.Lin Mechery Rural Housing Society to the Petitioner.
2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Special Government Pleader appearing for the respondents and perused the materials available on record.
3.

When the matter is taken up today, the learned Special Government Pleader appearing for the respondent submitted a letter addressed to Government Pleader by the District Collector, wherein it is stated that the survey has been conducted in the presence of the petitioner and encroachment has already been removed.
In view of the above report, no further Order is required in this Writ Petition.
4. Accordingly, this writ petition is closed.
